children: Ingalls Shipbuilding division will host an on-site hiring event from 8 a.m. to noon, Saturday, October 24 at the Ingalls Maritime Training Academy, 2721 Jerry St. Pé Highway, Pascagoula. The event is open to skilled, semi-skilled and entry-level applicants. Pre-registration is recommended and attendees should bring two forms of valid ID.

As the nation’s premier builder of Navy surface combatants and amphibious ships, Ingalls relies on a highly skilled workforce to deliver ships that support national security. The upcoming hiring event will give job seekers an opportunity to learn more about Ingalls’ mission, long-term career pathways and training opportunities. Veterans and transitioning service members are encouraged to attend the event to explore careers where military experience directly translates into mission-driven work.

“Every ship built by the hardworking men and women here at Ingalls contributes directly to America’s security,” said Susan Jacobs, Ingalls Shipbuilding vice president of human resources and administration. “We’re looking to hire people who want to be a part of that mission and who want stable, well-paying jobs that make a difference.”

Ingalls offers long-term career stability, competitive wages and comprehensive benefits supported by a strong pipeline of future work. The company provides weekly pay, market-driven wage increases for skilled trades, holiday pay, comprehensive medical plan options, financial wellness resources, and clear pathways for professional growth that stand out among employers across the region.
